# Iran War (disambiguation)

Iran War or Iranian War may refer to:
*2026 Iran war, a war principally between Iran, United States and Israel
*Iran–Iraq War (1980–1988)
*Iran–Israel conflict (disambiguation), several military conflicts between Iran and Israel
*Iran–United States war (disambiguation), several military conflicts between the United States and Iran
